subject: Adapter matrix + onboarding handshake — streaming, toolcalls, structured schema
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sara Malik <s.malik@novacare.com>, Michael Reynolds <michael.reynolds@novacare.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Adapter matrix + onboarding handshake — streaming, toolcalls, structured schema

Hi Sara / Michael —

Great to meet you at the pilot review last week. As promised, I’m starting the formal onboarding thread for NovaCare’s feature enablement: streaming responses, function/tool calling, and structured JSON outputs. Attached are the initial artifacts: adapter matrix (xlsx), schema_v1.json, and our runbook checklist.

High level plan (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): confirm adapter matrix and roles; SCIM/SAML contact + security intake.
- Week 1: schema review session (30–45m) + streaming smoke test (sample dataset).
- Week 2: toolcall integration (sandbox) + end-to-end structured-output validation.
- Week 3: go/no-go and production rollout window planning.

Please review the adapter matrix column labeled "Required Inputs" and confirm whether your payload will include the transaction_id and patient_metadata fields or if we should map them server-side. Also confirm the preferred kickoff time for Wed/Thu next week.

Attaching: nova_onboard_adapter_matrix.xlsx, schema_v1.json, runbook_stream_toolcall_checklist.pdf

Next steps for Redwood team: I’ve looped in Camila (integration lead), Grace (CS lead), and Ben (security liaison). Camila — can you propose owners for the streaming smoke test and provide estimated effort?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

—
Mina Haddad
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Michael Reynolds <michael.reynolds@novacare.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Malik <s.malik@novacare.com>, integration@novacare.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Adapter matrix + onboarding handshake — streaming, toolcalls, structured schema

Thanks, Mina — this plan looks good. A few notes from NovaCare: 

- We will provide transaction_id and patient_metadata in the streaming payloads. Mapping server-side is preferable only for legacy records; we’ll flag those.
- Security: procurement wants a copy of SOC2 scope and any multi-region data handling notes before we sign the sandbox addendum. Can Ben share the SOC2 pointer and a short note on data residency?
- Timeline: Wed (Nov 25) is a holiday for some of our EU folks; we prefer Tue Nov 24 or Thu Nov 26 for the schema review session (early PST).

We’ve attached a short internal doc (sent separately) with the list of internal folks who need read access. I’ve cc’d integration@novacare — they’ll coordinate onboarding credentials.

On the toolcall side, our integration engineer (Sara) will need a sample DocuSign flow and a mock external webhook example for testing.

—
Michael Reynolds
Head of Integrations, NovaCare HealthTech
michael.reynolds@novacare.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Malik <s.malik@novacare.com>, Michael Reynolds <michael.reynolds@novacare.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Adapter matrix + onboarding handshake — streaming, toolcalls, structured schema

(Internal) — forwarding Michael’s notes and confirming owners. Quoting Michael below for context.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Ben Carter: SOC2 pointer + short data residency note — EOD Wed 18 Nov. (security liaison)
- Camila Reyes: Prepare sandbox endpoints + streaming postman collection for smoke test — by Fri 20 Nov. (integration lead)
- Jasmine Liu: Create sample toolcall DocuSign flow and webhook harness (examples in runbook) — Tue 24 Nov. (solutions engineer)
- Grace O’Connor: Schedule schema review session with NovaCare and own agenda — propose two slots for Tue 24 / Thu 26 — by EOD Wed 18 Nov. (CS lead)

I’ll send an updated calendar invite once we confirm the slot. Camila — I put the adapter matrix column notes in the shared Drive folder (link below).

Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c
Attachments: nova_onboard_adapter_matrix.xlsx, schema_v1.json

Thanks team — let’s aim to close the sandbox access and SOC2 pointer by EOD Wed so we can run the smoke tests next week.

—
Mina

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Adapter matrix + onboarding handshake — streaming, toolcalls, structured schema

Confirmed — I’ve booked two provisional slots for the schema review: Tue Nov 24 10:00 PST and Thu Nov 26 09:00 PST. I’ll keep them tentative until NovaCare confirms.

Quick status updates:
- Sandbox endpoints: deployed to staging cluster (stg-redwood-12) — credentials pending. I’ve uploaded the Postman collection to the Drive folder and added notes about the streaming batch size defaults.
- Smoke test payloads: I created two templates in schema_v1.json (full payload + minimal payload) and included example env variables in the runbook.
- Toolcall examples: Jasmine — can you drop the DocuSign mock (signed-envelope.json) into the Drive runbook folder by EOD Mon? That will let NovaCare validate the webhook flow.

Ben — I saw the SOC2 summary in the security artifacts repo. Can you paste the short pointer (doc link + one-line residency guidance) in this thread so I can forward to procurement?

Thanks — Camila

Camila Reyes
Integration Lead, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0311
